newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips as techs, "year 2000" cos pare gains.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips as techs, "year 2000" cos pare gains.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index fell on Monday as technology shares were hit by continued investor caution over holiday results at consumer electronics retailers.
Among shares victimized by the broad tech sell-off, were Apple Computer Corp, which dropped 1-3/8 to 21-3/4 and Intel Corp, off 2-1/8 to 133-1/4. Dell Computer Corp slipped 3-11/16 to 52-1/4.
"The techs have had a nice run lately. Some of the selling is profit-taking. None of the fundamentals of the major techs changed today," one trader said.

Shares of computer service companies specializing in developing solutions to the so-called Year 2000 bug also had a wild reversal after some questioned whether or not interest in the sector was reaching manic proportions.

Zitel Corp crumbled from a morning high of 72-7/8 to close at 41, down 20-1/4. Other "millennium" companies included Accelr8 Technology Corp, which fell 5-1/8 to 16-3/8 and TSR Inc, which tumbled from an intraday high of 50-1/4 to close at 30. The Nasdaq Composite dropped 3.63 to 1287.75. The Dow slipped 12 to close at 6549.
